description: Every ring statement and its public input HashChain4(elements). The transfer head is [CRTX, n0, ring_id, pack_be(0x04 || tx_u), pack_be(auditor_pubkey), digest(envelope), salt, layout] with the frame's random salt and layout = has_data | entry << 1. digest(ct) = Poseidon(u32 len(ct), HashChain4(pack_left31(ct))). Each envelope has the length of its stream layout. The transfer statements are HashChain4 over the audit head under CRTX, in_proof, hidden, delegate, approval_mask, no_spend, output_count, output_chain, record_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(record_i)), tail_chain HashChain4(hash_bytes(tail_i)) or zero while has_data is clear, input_count, input_nullifier_chain, private_tx_hash, the sender, the party identities, signer_count, signer_chain, policy_hash, own_root, curator_root, tracking_root, asset, net and gross per public slot, withdrawal_hash and the element count. No body, tag, bundle or reply digest and no slot class enters it. Every per-slot chain is zero filled to the capacity. signer_chain is HashChain4 over the deduplicated owner identities zero filled to the key's S, and zero when signer_count is zero on every rail. The apply statement ends at the restrictive bit, and a private key appends private_writes and the tracking root. Produced by program-libs/interface/tests/statements.rs.
